notes.title: ConflictCraft 2 is now available on Steam!!!
notes.content:
ConflictCraft 2 is the sequel to the original game which became surprisingly popular and beloved by nearly 200K players on Steam! For this reason alone we've decided to release a brand new title that's far more compelling and in-depth from a tactical point of view.

We come with 53 new levels much more complicated than levels from first ConflictCraft. It took a lot of work to bring to life this new version. We didn't raise the prices at all, they will be the same with the original game.

[b]Game Features:[/b]
- 53 challenging levels to complete.
- Level Editor allowing complex map customization.
- Large selection of competing nations & factions.
- 32 steam achievements

[b]Grab the game right now!!![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1877370/ConflictCraft_2__Game_of_the_Year_Edition/

notes.title: Need for Spirit: Drink & Drive Simulator is coming on 5 september!
notes.content:
Dear players,
[h1]7 days left until you will can put your own skills to the test in a parody that absolutely does not encourage drunk driving in real life[/h1]

Need for Spirit: Drink & Drive Simulator is a tongue-in-cheek racer, unique through its approach to the racing topic. You step into the shoes of a hapless professional driver tasked with transporting various alcoholic beverages such as beer, spirits, wine and brandy to certain venues like birthdays and other miscellaneous celebrations.

If you thought this mission will be easy, think again. The infrastructure will be challenging to say the least. Country roads, mountains and highways that resemble dirt roads will all prove to be worthy adversaries on your path towards a successful delivery.

Abysmal roads aside, the biggest enemy will be your very own addiction to the booze you’re transporting. Potholes seem harmless after you’ve transformed into an insatiable drunkard which suddenly thinks that he’s got the off-road skills to take as many shortcuts as needed. The most inaccessible corners of the map no longer seem like obstacles.

Really, what are YOU waiting for? Rev that engine, empty a couple of bottles and put your own skills to the test in a parody that absolutely does not encourage drunk driving in real life. Stick to video games and that hangover will disappear faster than flipping the wheels in this simulation!

Key features :
- Unique gameplay featuring eight levels with deserts, forests, rural roads and highways.
- Three camera modes.
- Four booze types as the main commodity and foe.
- The high probability of experiencing drunk vision.
- Challenging driving highlighted by obstacles and time limits.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/924670/Need_for_Spirit_Drink__Drive_Simulator/

notes.title: NEW UPDATE v1.4 North Korea update, -90% off & much more now available!!!
notes.content:
Dear players,
[h1]The Last Hope Trump vs Mafia - North Korea update is now available!!![/h1]

Last month we announced that we're working on a very cool update, the icing on the cake being a new country, North Korea.

[h1]So what's new in the update v1.4?[/h1]
1. After reading the reviews we concluded that first part of the game(office, airport & airplane) were boring for players this is why we deleted them and from the beginning of the game, when you press "NEW GAME", you enter in action directly from [h1]NORTH KOREA[/h1]! 
Below are some screenshots from this new country:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27478518/0d79f37247b5eb8eb5da19a96deccf2f8771394f.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27478518/51949d1d61bc58eaf6be5430e5b04c9bc1e4e414.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27478518/bf483b5cf02f0e5984b54af91c3dfd112dc04dbf.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27478518/f11fbb4a9144fe356f77d3837c0b3be23cf9966f.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27478518/990b8b502f332c1b7c771a02aa49e6ea5746ec4c.jpg[/img]

2. We changed the order of levels, now they are with difficult from easy to hard, not more randomly as they were. Order of countries: North Korea, China, France, Moldova, Turkey, Canada, USA.

3. We made France level much easier and much clearer for player. [h1]This level is shorter with 15%.[/h1]

4. [h1]We added more lights in Cricova tunnels, Moldova.[/h1] In reviews & in mails users said that is too dark.

5. [h1]The build of the game was exported from Unity 5.5.1 to Unity 2017.2 [/h1]. This mean a better user experience, a much stable build and better graphics.

6. China level difficulty was reduced with 20%

Note: Windows XP, 8.1  users can get a blue screen while loading to Moldova & Turkey level. This doesn't affect the process of loading of new levels but in next update we will try to fix it.

 [h1]You get control to all countries!!!
 Now, you are the president of the World.[/h1]

Enter in your presidential mission starting with Northern Korea right now!
[h1]Play it right now with -90% for a limited period of time)[/h1]
